page.layout: One page of text. Top: page number "(59)" centred, then a title "Alphabetum Arabicum." Below it a three-column table with the headings Nomen, Figura, Poteftas, then rows of Arabic letters with their names and values. Below the table one block of running text in paragraphs. "Eædem." is printed at the lower right, as catchword.

main_text.head: Alphabetum Arabicum.
main_text.p: In Columnis, prima exhibet literas initiales, secunda medias, quæ plerunq; aliis connectun-tur, tertia finales quæ non connectuntur cum præcedentibus, quarta finales connexas cum præcedentibus: sex tamen sunt literæ quæ se-quenti conjungi non possunt, scil. [illegible, ~6 letters] ideóque initiales post eas usurpantur etiam in medio dictionis.
Elif & Lam conjunguntur ut in tabula ; & quidem cùm alteri literæ non connectuntur, sic Ȳ. cùm connectuntur hoc modo ȝ, aliquando sic [illegible, ~2 letters], vel sic [illegible, ~2 letters]
Quæ litera, Te, The, Nun, & Je, mutatis punctis inservit, sæpè invertitur ante Gjim, Hha, & Cha, sic [illegible, ~2 letters]

page.notes: Arabic letter figures (Figura column and the inline forms in the text) are not legible enough to transcribe; each is marked illegible. "infervit" is printed with a long s that looks like f; read as inservit. Printed "usurpantur" appears as "ufurpantur" and "post" as "poft"; spelling of the printed text is kept in the paragraph where legible, with the printer's long s normalised. The Arabic figure at the very bottom right of the page and the small stroke marks above the table are not text and are left out.
